Apex Global Solutions LLC (2024-CV-14509), we have assessed the viability of the plaintiff's Sherman Act Section 1 price-fixing claim. A key development is the Seventh Circuit's recent decision in National Medical Devices Alliance v. FTC (2024 WL 5567891), which held that private antitrust claims concerning medical device pricing are preempted by the Medical Device Amendments to the FD&C Act (21 U.S.C. § 360k). This precedent directly undermines subject matter jurisdiction in the present case, as federal regulatory authority over medical device pricing may preclude antitrust enforcement. In light of this, we have filed a Motion to Dismiss under Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(b)(6), arguing that the complaint fails to state a claim upon which relief can be granted. The opposition is due by February 15, 2025, with a reply due by February 22, 2025. We recommend continued focus on jurisdictional defenses and preparation for potential summary judgment should the motion be denied.
